## Figure S1

The point of figure 1 is to show the reader how genes that change during differentiation were assigned.  

Why did we chose the data sets. 

The bulk RNAseq was sequenced quite deeply which allows us to clearly assign a transcriptional start site for each of our genes.  Many of the canonical transcriptional start sites were not correct.

Hatten TRAP data gives us the later time points which are not available in purified cells or any single cell suspension as much of the RNA is in processes. 

The Taylor lab scRNAseq allows us to remove contaminated genes. 


Details on gene selection. 

To indentify epigenetic regulators of differentiation we needed an accurate and complete list of genes that change during differentiation. 




A. Genes that are excluded 
B. Genes that transcriptionally change 
C.

```{r, fig.height= 6, fig.width= 6}
                  aes(x = Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30), 
                      y = Winsorize(avg_fc, minval = -7.5, maxval = 7.5),

           point.padding = 1,
           box.padding = 0.25,
           size = 6, 
           seed = 4, 
           colour = "darkorchid2",
           min.segment.length = 0, 
           force = 20 
            ) + 
     geom_text_repel(data = subset(sce_agg_merged_cc_ann, mgi_symbol %in% label_genes
                                  & max_cat == "P14_P56" 
                                  & avg_fc >=  6), 
                  aes(x = Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30), 
                      y = Winsorize(avg_fc, minval = -7.5, maxval = 7.5), 
           label = mgi_symbol), 
           point.padding = 1,
           box.padding = 0.25,
           size = 6, 
           seed = 22,

    geom_text_repel(data = subset(sce_agg_merged_cc_ann, mgi_symbol %in% label_genes 
                                  & max_cat == "P14_P56"
                                  & avg_fc < 3), 
                  aes(x = Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30), 
                      y = Winsorize(avg_fc, minval = -7.5, maxval = 7.5), 
           label = mgi_symbol), 
           point.padding = 1,
           box.padding = 0.25,
           size = 6, 
           seed = 2, 
           colour = "darkorchid2",
           min.segment.length = 0, 
           force = 30, 
           nudge_y = 1.5,
           nudge_x = -1) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,2,4,6)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_points, 
                     labels = names(time_points), 
                     name = "Time at 50% max change") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c( "Increase late" = "royalblue3",  "Increase mid" = "darkorange3", "other" = "grey")) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = k2color[,1]) +
```

```{r}
sce_agg_merged_cc_ann <- sce_agg_merged_cc_ann %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(max_cat_exclude =
                 case_when(
      max_cat == "E15" &  avg_min > 6 ~ "E15",
      max_cat == "E15" &  avg_min <= 6 ~ "E15_exclude",
      max_cat == "P0_7" &  (avg_min  < 6 | avg_min > 20) ~ "P0_P7",
      max_cat == "P0_7" &  (avg_min  >= 6 | avg_min <= 20) ~ "P0_P7_exclude",
      max_cat == "P14_P56" &  avg_min < 19  ~ "P14_P56",
      max_cat == "P14_P56" &  avg_min >= 19 ~ "P14_P56_exclude",
      TRUE                                                                                      ~ "other"
    )
)
```

Make the sankey plot 

Example code from https://r-charts.com/flow/sankey-diagram-ggplot2/



What order do you want to screen genes 
Step 1: Remove unexpressed genes 
Step 2: Remove genes that are expressed but are contaminant 
Step 3: Remove genes that are not changing 
Step 4: Split genes by max time 
Step 5: Statistical testing of each group
E15 DE  E15-P7 S 
P0-7   E15-P7 S AND P7-P14 S AND P7-P21 H 
P14-56  P7-P14 S AND P7-P21 S AND P7-P21 H  
Minimal FC cutoff for each 





For the supplementary data would want to show a figure for each fo the steps in gene exclusion 

Step 1: Remove unexpressed genes 
Figure: scatter plot of Scott vs Hatten transcript data
Colour the genes of selected versus unselected 

Step 2: Remove genes that are expressed but are contaminant 
Figure showing relative counts of each dataset 

Step 3a: Remove genes that are not changing 
Fold change 

Step 3b: Split genes by max time 
max vs min time 
E15, P0-7, P14-P56 

Step 5: Statistical testing of each group
t50 vs fold change selected verus not

Code from https://rpubs.com/techanswers88/sankey-with-own-data-in-ggplot

Ugly 
If you change anything like adding new variables you need to add them to the colour vector 
The position of the names in the colour vector determines their order 



```{r}
library(forcats)

long_sce_temp <- sce_agg_merged_cc_ann %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(expr)) %>%
 #dplyr::mutate(max_cat2 = as.character(max_cat)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(max_cat2 = ifelse(max_cat == "unexpressed", "excluded", max_cat)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(max_cat2 = ifelse(max_cat2 == "P14_P56", "P14 to P56", max_cat2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(max_cat2 = ifelse(max_cat2 == "P0_7", "P0 to P7", max_cat2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step1 = factor(expr)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step1 = recode(step1, "TRUE" = "Expressed", "FALSE" = "Unexpressed")) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(step2 = ifelse(expr == FALSE, "excluded", group_1)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step2 = ifelse(group_1 %in% c("Dynically expressed in granule neuron lineage", "Unchanged expression"), "Granule neuron lineage", step2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step2 = ifelse(max_cat ==  "unexpressed",  "excluded", step2)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(step2 = recode(step2, "Granule neuron lineage" = "Granule neuron lineages", 
                                      "Contaminated genes" = "Alternative lineage",
                                      "Cell cycle" = "Cell cycle",
                                      "excluded" = "excluded"))

long_sce_temp <- long_sce_temp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step3 = ifelse( avg_fc >=  1, "Dynamically expressed", "unchanged")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step3 = ifelse(expr == FALSE, "excluded", step3)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step3 = ifelse(group_1 %in% c("Cell cycle", "Contaminated genes", "Unexpressed"), "excluded", step3)) 

long_sce_temp <- long_sce_temp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step4 = cut(avg_max, c(0,2,20,64), right=FALSE, labels=c("E15", "P0 to P7", "P14 to P56"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step4 = as.character(step4)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step4 = ifelse(step3 == "Dynamically expressed", step4, step3)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step4 = ifelse(expr == FALSE, "excluded", step4))  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step4 = ifelse(grepl("_exclude", max_cat_exclude), "incompatible max-min", step4)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step4 = ifelse(step3 == "excluded", "excluded", step4 ))
  
long_sce_temp <-  long_sce_temp %>%
   dplyr::mutate(step5 = step4) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step5 = ifelse(!(exclude_cat %in% c("other", "GN_expressed_not_changing")), "excluded", max_cat2 )) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step5 = ifelse( step4 %in% c("E15", "P0 to P7", "P14 to P56") & max_cat2 == "unchanged", "p-val inadequate", step4)) %>%
   dplyr::mutate(step5 = ifelse(grepl("_exclude", max_cat_exclude), "excluded", step5)) 
  
long_sce_temp <-  long_sce_temp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step5b = step5) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step5b = ifelse(t50_cat == "Early" & max_cat2 == "P14 to P56", "increase before P0", step5b ))  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step5b = ifelse(step5b == "p-val inadequate", "unchanged", step5b )) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step5b = ifelse(expr == FALSE, "excluded", step5b)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step5b = ifelse(group_1 %in% c("Cell cycle", "Contaminated genes", "Unexpressed"), "excluded", step5b)) %>%
 dplyr::mutate(step5b = ifelse(grepl("_exclude", max_cat_exclude), "excluded", step5b))


long_sce_temp <- long_sce_temp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step6 = case_when(  
    avg_fc < 1                ~  "0-1 log2FC",
    avg_fc >=1 & avg_fc < 2   ~  "1-2 log2FC", 
    avg_fc >= 2               ~  ">2 log2FC"     
    ))  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step6 = paste(step5, step6) ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step6 = ifelse((step5 %in% c("E15", "P0 to P7", "P14 to P56")), step6, "excluded" )) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step6 = ifelse(step5b  ==  "increase before P0", "excluded", step6 ))  
  
long_sce_temp <- long_sce_temp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step7 = case_when(  
    step6 == "P14 to P56 >2 log2FC" ~  "differentiation genes",
    step6 == "P0 to P7 >2 log2FC"   ~  "proliferation genes",
    step6 == "E15 >2 log2FC" ~ "embryonic genes"
    #TRUE                            ~ "other"
    ))
  

long_sce <-   long_sce_temp %>%
  #dplyr::select(common_id, max_t50_cat, group_1, group_2) %>%
  ggsankey::make_long( step1, step2, step3, step4, step5, step5b, step6, step7)# %>%
  #dplyr::mutate(node = factor(node))


dagg <- long_sce%>%
  dplyr::group_by(x,node)%>%
  tally()


long_sce <- long_sce %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(dagg, by=c('x'='x', 'node'='node'))

```

Build the horizontal Sankey plot 

```{r, fig.width= 6, fig.height= 3.5}

# Define the custom colors using RColorBrewer

re_order_sankey <- c("Expressed",  "Granule neuron lineages", "Dynamically expressed", "P14 to P56", "P0 to P7", "E15", "Cell cycle", "Alternative lineage", "increase before P0", "incompatible max-min", "p-val inadequate", "P14 to P56 >2 log2FC", "P14 to P56 1-2 log2FC", "P0 to P7 >2 log2FC", "P0 to P7 1-2 log2FC", "E15 >2 log2FC", "E15 1-2 log2FC", "differentiation genes", "proliferation genes", "embryonic genes",  "unchanged", "excluded", "Unexpressed", NA)
re_order_sankey <- rev(re_order_sankey)

long_sce$node <- factor(long_sce$node, levels = re_order_sankey, ordered = TRUE )

long_sce <- long_sce %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(node) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(node), desc(next_node)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(node))

# purple for scRNAseq data 

sankey_colours <- c("white","gray40", "gray60", "lightblue4", "springgreen4", "red3", "royalblue3",  "springgreen1", "springgreen4", "red1", "red3", "royalblue1", "royalblue3", "lightblue2", "lightblue2" , "lightblue2", "mediumpurple", "mediumorchid", "springgreen3", "red2", "royalblue2", "dodgerblue3", "dodgerblue2", "dodgerblue")
# Assign custom colors to the variable names
names(sankey_colours) <-  re_order_sankey

#sankey_colours["increase before P0"] <- "lightblue2"


max_cat_names <- list( E15 = "Maximum at E15", P0_7 = "Maximum at P0 to P7", P14_P56 =  "Maximum at P14 to P56")
max_cat_labeller <- function(variable,value){
  return(max_cat_names[value])
}


sankey_x_labs <- c("Remove genes unexpressed during the time course", "Remove genes that are contaminated from other cell lines", "Remove genes that change less then 2 fold", "Split changing genes based on when they arive at max", "Remove genes based on individual dataset differntial expression adjusted p-val" )

sankey_x_labs_nl <- c("Step 1:\nRemove genes \nunexpressed during \nthe time course", 
                   "Step 2:\nRemove genes \ncontaminated\nfrom other cell lines\nTaylor scRNAseq",
                   "Step 3:\nRemove genes that\nchange less\nthen 2 fold",
                   "Step 4:\nSplit changing genes\nbased on when they\narrive at max",
                   "Step 5:\nRemove genes with \nadjusted p-val > 0.001 \nin differential expression \nfrom RNAseq or NeuroD1-TRAP",
                   "Step 6:\nRemove differentiation\ngenes that\nincrease most\nprior to P0",
                   "Step 7:\nSeperate\nby fold change",
                   "Step 8:\nFinal groups")

fc_cat_labeller <- function(var){
  
  fc_lab <- str_replace(var, "P14 to P56 ", "")
  fc_lab <- str_replace(fc_lab, "P0 to P7 ", "")
  fc_lab <- str_replace(fc_lab, "E15 ", "")
  return(fc_lab)
}


gene_sankey_p <- long_sce %>%
 ggplot( aes(x = x, 
               next_x = next_x, 
               node = node, 
               next_node = next_node,
               fill =node,
             #color = node,
               label = paste0(fc_cat_labeller(node),"\nn=", n))) +
   
  #geom_sankey(node.color = 1, flow.alpha = .6, width = 0.25) +
  geom_sankey( flow.alpha = .6, width = 0.25) +
   #geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "white", space = 0.1)  +
   geom_sankey_text(size = 4, color = "black")  +
  theme_sankey(base_size = 16) + 
   scale_fill_manual(values = sankey_colours) +
   scale_x_discrete(labels =sankey_x_labs_nl) +
       xlab(NULL)+
   theme(legend.position = "none", 
         axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10)) 
   

plot(gene_sankey_p)
  
table(sce_agg_merged_cc_ann$max_cat, sce_agg_merged_cc_ann$group_1)
```

```{r, fig.width= 5, fig.height= 3.5}
                   "\nStep 4:\nSplit genes\nbased on time of\nmax and min\nexpression",
                   "\nStep 5:\nRemove genes\np-val > 0.001\nin differential\nexpression",
                   "\nStep 6:\nRemove\ndifferentiation\ngenes that\nincrease most\nprior to P0",
                   "\n\n\nStep 7:\nSeperate\nby fold change",
                   "Final groups")

fc_cat_labeller <- function(var){
  
  fc_lab <- str_replace(var, "P14 to P56 ", "")
  fc_lab <- str_replace(fc_lab, "P0 to P7 ", "")
  fc_lab <- str_replace(fc_lab, "E15 ", "")
  return(fc_lab)
}
```

Code to transform the axis to best use the plot space 

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/35511951/r-ggplot2-collapse-or-remove-segment-of-y-axis-from-scatter-plot

```{r}
library(scales)
squish_trans <- function(from, to, factor) {
  
  trans <- function(x) {
    
    if (any(is.na(x))) return(x)

    # get indices for the relevant regions
    isq <- x > from & x < to
    ito <- x >= to
    
    # apply transformation
    x[isq] <- from + (x[isq] - from)/factor
    x[ito] <- from + (to - from)/factor + (x[ito] - to)
    
    return(x)
  }

  inv <- function(x) {
    
    if (any(is.na(x))) return(x)

    # get indices for the relevant regions
    isq <- x > from & x < from + (to - from)/factor
    ito <- x >= from + (to - from)/factor
    
    # apply transformation
    x[isq] <- from + (x[isq] - from) * factor
    x[ito] <- to + (x[ito] - (from + (to - from)/factor))
    
    return(x)
  }
  
  # return the transformation
  return(trans_new("squished", trans, inv))
}

```

```{r 2fc_kmeans}

ens_tx_dyn_exp <- sce_agg_merged_cc_ann %>%
  dplyr::filter(group_1 == "Dynically expressed in granule neuron lineage") %>%
  dplyr::select(ensembl_transcript_id)

diff1_all_dyn <- diff1_all[row.names(diff1_all) %in% ens_tx_dyn_exp$ensembl_transcript_id,]

km_diff1 <- kmeans(diff1_all_dyn, centers = 15,  nstart=50,iter.max = 15) 



km_diff1_df <- data.frame(ensembl_transcript_id = names(km_diff1$cluster), dyn_k15 = km_diff1$cluster)

sce_agg_merged_cc_ann_k <- sce_agg_merged_cc_ann %>%
  dplyr::left_join(km_diff1_df, by = c('ensembl_transcript_id'='ensembl_transcript_id')) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dyn_k15 = factor(dyn_k15))

# reorder using the max and t50 vvalues 
dyn_k15_summary <- sce_agg_merged_cc_ann_k %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dyn_k15)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(dyn_k15) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(avg_t50 = mean(avg_t50), 
                   avg_fc =  mean(avg_fc), 
                   avg_max = mean(avg_max), 
                   avg_min = mean(avg_min)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(avg_max), avg_min, desc(avg_fc), desc(avg_t50)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dyn_k15o = 1:15) 

dyn_k15_recode <- dyn_k15_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(dyn_k15, dyn_k15o) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dyn_k15o = factor(dyn_k15o))

sce_agg_merged_cc_ann_k$dyn_k15 <- plyr::mapvalues(sce_agg_merged_cc_ann_k$dyn_k15, from = dyn_k15_recode$dyn_k15, to = dyn_k15_recode$dyn_k15o )
```
